description: Rackets: prepare (unsigned) collecting what a crew of Operatives has earned (Rackets.claim): the ZENI the crew is owed goes to your wallet together with its Rep, minus any raid debt. Only the crew's owner can claim. Pass crewId (my_assets lists yours); if you own exactly one crew with something to claim it can be left out. Refused with the reason if the crew is not yours or has nothing to claim. Costs only gas.

crewId.description: The crew id (my_assets crews list). Optional when you have one crew with something to claim.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read holdings and to simulate.

name: prepare_claim_operative_earnings
